$comment: Provisional: the reference definition of the implementation guide (Section 11.4), from the kinds and attributes of [FW] Section 3.6, stands in for [IMPL] Annex B until it arrives; work item D.3 replaces it.
title: MetricEntry
description: A metric: its unit and value, the class of managed object it describes, its definition and the kinds of source that supply it.

owner.description: The owner of the entry: the domain owner, framework or kpi-definitions.

deprecated.description: A deprecated entry stays resolvable; admission warns new descriptors.

type.description: How the metric behaves over time.

aggregation.description: The aggregation over a window: mean, max, min, last or sum.

sources.description: The source kinds that supply the metric.
